# ExamO / 易考鸥

> Course-Aware AI Study Assistant. This is public product documentation, not access to the learning service. Core source remains private.

Reviewed: 2026-10-19. Implemented study workflows have not been verified as a public production release by this review. In-app schedules have implementation foundations; background reminders and autonomous AI Study Agent execution are Planned.
